facts.help: Bring in our own posted agenda
agenda.load: bring the posted council agenda in: the meeting, its items in order, and the public-comment list on the hearing item.
agenda.next <meeting>: move the meeting on to its next item, so everyone following sees what is being heard now. Its group's leaders may.

facts.name: council
facts.text:
root : column, role sheet
  meetings : column, of tag:meeting as m, each meet
  pulse : column, of tag:poll as p, each poll
  news : column, of tag:post as f, by pinned, each story
  rides : column, of tag:carpool as c, each ride
meet : column, role card
  h : text "$m.title", role title
  w : text "$m.at_said · $m.where", role meta
  now : text "Now: $m.now_title"
  items : column, of tag:item,meeting=$m.id as i, by order, each agendum
agendum : column
  t : text "$i.order. $i.title"
  sign : row, only when $i.seats > 0
    left : text "$i.seats_left of $i.seats two-minute slots open · closes $i.closes_said", role meta
    speak : text "Sign up to speak", role tool, on click do claim $item
  who : text "Speaking: $i.claimed_by", role meta, only when $i.claims > 0
  notes : column, of tag:summary,about=$i.id as s, each note
note : column, role card
  by : text "$s.by · a draft, not the minutes", role meta
  x : text "$s.text"
poll : column, role card
  q : text "$p.title", role title
  n : text "yes $p.votes_yes · no $p.votes_no · sealed: counts only", role meta
  b : row
    y : text "yes", role tool, on click do vote $item yes
    no : text "no", role tool, on click do vote $item no
story : column, role card
  pin : text "pinned by $f.pinned", role meta, only when $f.pinned != ""
  by : text "$f.by", role meta
  t : text "$f.text"
  about : text "see: $f.about_title", role meta, only when $f.about != ""
ride : row
  r : text "$c.pickup to City Hall · leaves $c.leaves · $c.seats_left left"
  go : text "ride", role tool, on click do claim $item

facts.name: floor
facts.text:
root : column, role sheet, of tag:meeting as m, each meet
meet : column, role card
  h : text "$m.title", role title
  now : text "Now: $m.now_title"
  next : text "Next item", role tool, on click do agenda.next $item
  items : column, of tag:item,meeting=$m.id as i, by order, each agendum
agendum : column
  t : text "$i.order. $i.title"
  who : text "Speakers, in order: $i.claimed_by", role meta, only when $i.claims > 0
  c : text "Call-backs: $i.contacts", role meta, only when $i.claims > 0
